facts.fact: The APDP session was convened under article 39 of Law 2013-015 of 21 May 2013, as amended.
The APDP opened its first ordinary session of 2026 on 2 February 2026, examining more than 500 compliance files, sanction procedures and its annual inspection programme.

facts.fact: The APDP is deliberating on more than 500 compliance files submitted by public and private bodies in a session opened 2 February 2026.
